purpose: Frozen before any outcomes on these queries; natural requests omit expert names. Identity labels are incomplete and require original-role relevance review.

cases.zh: 结账突然全挂了，现在需要有人统一安排排查和恢复，把影响用户、处理经过和后续整改整理清楚。
cases.en: Checkout has just failed across the site. Coordinate the investigation and recovery, establish affected users, document the response and follow-up improvements.

cases.zh: 把服务从4个处理进程改成8个之后是否真有收益？请控制数据和请求不变，模拟突发流量，比较慢请求、吞吐和出错情况。
cases.en: Does changing the service from four processing workers to eight actually help? Hold data and requests fixed, simulate traffic bursts and compare slow requests, throughput and errors.

cases.zh: 客户A居然能猜编号打开客户B的账单，修完后要系统查一下还有哪些类似入口，交付风险分析和验证过程。
cases.en: Customer A can guess an identifier and open customer B's invoice. After repairing it, systematically inspect related entry points and deliver a risk analysis and verification evidence.

cases.zh: 凌晨搬运业务记录的程序断电后重跑就多出重复数据，有时还丢记录；需要设计能安全重放、监控质量的整套数据处理方案。
cases.en: After a power cut, replaying our overnight business-record ingestion duplicates some records and loses others. Design safe replay and a complete data-processing solution with quality monitoring.

cases.zh: 新用户走到绑定手机就不继续了，先别凭直觉改页面；找用户实际观察，设计研究找原因，再看新方案是否改善。
cases.en: New users stop when they reach phone linking. Before changing pages on intuition, observe real users, design research to identify causes and test whether a new design improves the experience.

cases.zh: 想增加团队邀请功能，从澄清需求到合并都帮我组织起来，能独立做的分出去，先有失败测试，再分别检查需求符合性和代码质量。
cases.en: Organize delivery of team invitations from requirement clarification to merge. Delegate independent work, establish failing tests first, then separately review requirement compliance and code quality.

cases.zh: 盲人用户说购物流程根本操作不了，请拿读屏和纯键盘逐步检查，按WCAG给出问题、修改和复测证据。
cases.en: Blind users cannot complete shopping. Check the flow step by step with a screen reader and keyboard only; provide WCAG findings, repairs and retest evidence.

cases.zh: 我有一篇关于城市热岛与老年健康的论文摘要，想同时评估中文核心和SCI投稿选择，给出冲稳保方案以及选刊依据。
cases.en: I have an abstract on urban heat islands and older adults' health. Evaluate Chinese core journals and SCI journals in parallel, giving ambitious, realistic and safe submission options with evidence.

cases.zh: 付费广告报表里很多实际搜索词和商品无关，请找出浪费预算的词，整理否定词结构，并核验调整后高意向流量有没有增加。
cases.en: Many actual search terms in our paid-ad reports are unrelated to the products. Identify wasted spending, organize negative keywords and verify whether changes increase high-intent traffic.

cases.zh: 把各地区销售人员提交的数据汇总为实时看板，展示区域、销售代表和商机漏斗，能让主管定位差距和机会。
cases.en: Consolidate submissions from salespeople across territories into a live dashboard showing territory, rep and pipeline summaries so managers can locate gaps and opportunities.

cases.zh: 我们每月要处理承包商账单和供应商付款，请设计自动处理流程，验证收款方，保留完整审计，并支持法币和稳定币渠道。
cases.en: We process contractor invoices and vendor payments monthly. Design automated handling with payee verification, a complete audit trail and support for fiat and stablecoin rails.

cases.zh: TAB实验的结果和手工查询对不上，需要先对齐指标口径，再分群下钻，校正多重比较后判断差异是否可信。
cases.en: Our TAB experiment results disagree with manual queries. Align metric definitions first, drill into cohorts and correct multiple comparisons before judging whether differences are credible.

limitations: Investigator-written diagnostic set; no independent blinded annotation and no completed expert task executions.
Identity misses may include equivalent experts; inspect original roles before calling them irrelevant.
